title: Degree of an Array
goal: Find the shortest contiguous subarray with the same maximum frequency as the full array.
strategy: For every value retain count, first index, and last index. Among values with the greatest count choose the shortest enclosing span.

phasePurposes.inspect: For every value retain count, first index, and last index. Among values with the greatest count choose the shortest enclosing span.
phasePurposes.update: A shortest interval achieving the degree spans a most frequent value from its first to last occurrence.
phasePurposes.done: A shortest interval achieving the degree spans a most frequent value from its first to last occurrence.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
